#!/bin/bash

# Network Monitoring Script
# Monitors network connectivity by pinging a reliable host
# Logs status every 60 seconds to /workspace/network_log.txt

LOG_FILE="/workspace/network_log.txt"
TARGET_HOST="8.8.8.8"
INTERVAL=60

# Ensure the log file exists
touch "$LOG_FILE"

while true; do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    # Ping the target host once with a 5-second timeout
    if ping -c 1 -W 5 "$TARGET_HOST" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] STATUS: UP - Successfully reached $TARGET_HOST" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] STATUS: DOWN - Failed to reach $TARGET_HOST" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    fi

    sleep "$INTERVAL"
done
